system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

As a Hoshigaki, your physical features are unique and different from everyone around you. Your clan is known for aqua blue skin, recessed eyes, gill like features on your face or neck, and the unique ability to breath in water as easily as breathing air. But this is surface level. When peering deeper, you will find that all Hoshigaki carry features of these deep-sea predators of different degrees. Select two Predator Traits. You gain an additional selection at 7th and 15th levels.

Apex Gaze

When an enemy look into your eyes, they see an Apex predator. A beast of a person who doesn’t see them as an equal, but as prey. You can take the Demoralize skill action as a Bonus action, and you can attempt it on creatures any number of times instead of once per hour.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the ranks of Demoralized you inflict by +1. Beginning at 15th level, when you take the Demoralize skill action, you can instead target all creatures you can see within 20 feet of you.

Beast of the Sea

Your stamina is unmatched. Increase your Hit points and Chakra points by an amount equal to your level.

Commander of the Deep

You learn a modified version of the Summoning Technique Ninjutsu, with a contract with the Shark tribe. The Shark tribe you are contracted with are a bit more versatile than other shark tribes. When you summon these sharks, they are summoned in a large bubble of Water that they use for land travel, using half their swimming speed to traverse the land.

Shark Skinned

Your skin is rough, slightly scaled, tougher and more resilient to damage. While you are not wearing Heavy Armor, you have Bonus DR equal to your constitution modifier. Beginning at 11th level, when a creature would deal damage to you with a melee attack, they take slashing damage, equal to your Constitution modifier.

Tide Locked

Your close affinity with water release chakra, makes your innate control over it uniquely suited to deal with extremely aggressive foes. Once per turn, when you deal cold damage to a creature as a result of a jutsu you cast with the Water Release keyword, you can select one of the affected creatures to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, you can choose to have either their speed reduced by 10 until the end of their next turn (This reduction becomes 20 at 7th and 30 at 15th level), or increase chakra damage they take by +2 until the beginning of your next turn. (This damage bonus increases to +4 at 7th and +6 at 15th level.)

Tiger Sharks Maw

Your teeth are sharp, serrated and can tear through flesh with ease. Losing teeth for you is a minor inconvenience since you regrow teeth like people regrow nails. You gain a special Bite Attack, which you can use in place of an attack made with your attack action.

Bite. Make a melee jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see or sense. On a hit, you deal 1d8 + your jutsu ability modifier in piercing damage. This attack has a +1 bonus to its critical threat range. Beginning at 7th level, creatures who take damage from your bite must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are Grappled by you. Beginning at 15th level, creatures that fail their saving throw also gain 1 rank of Bleed.

Prey Sense

Your senses are tuned to grant you awareness to those close enough to be considered a victim to your assault. You gain 10 feet of blindsight.

Beginning at 7th level, increase your blindsight to 20 feet, and it doubles while submerged in water.

Beginning at 15th level, increase your blindsight to 30 feet.
